subject: SOC 2 & DPA — propose condensed two-part walkthrough
messages:
From: Alice Parker <alice@acme.io>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: SecurityOps Team <secops@acme.io>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 & DPA walkthrough — propose a condensed two-part session

Hi Michael,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We need a joint session to cover two things for our procurement and security review: a high-level SOC 2 controls walkthrough (architecture, data flow, encryption, retention) and a focused DPA evidence handoff (where to find attestations and the behavior of data retention policies). To minimize calendar friction, would Redwood be open to a condensed two-part meeting: 45 minutes for architecture + controls, followed by a 30-minute evidence handoff / Q&A?

Proposed windows (our side, PST):
- Mon 21 Jun: 9:30–11:00 or 14:00–15:30
- Tue 22 Jun: 10:00–11:30 or 16:00–17:30

If those don't work, we can split into separate days. I attached our current DPA questionnaire and a simple evidence index so your team can pre-map items.

Can you confirm who from Redwood should attend (engineering, product, security lead)? Also flag a preferred calendar slot and we’ll send an invite with a VPN bridge if needed.

Appreciate it—
Alice Parker
Security Program Manager, Acme Payments
Attachments: DPA-questionnaire-v2.pdf, SOC2-evidence-index.xlsx
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Alice Parker <alice@acme.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 & DPA walkthrough — propose a condensed two-part session

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear proposal and the attachments, very helpful.

We can do the two-part format and recommend the following lineup from our side:
- Michael Grant (security/product integration) — will lead controls walkthrough
- Laura Bennett (platform eng) — will cover data flow and encryption details
- Ben Carter (customer security lead) — will manage the evidence handoff and follow-ups

Our preferred slots (PST):
- Tue 22 Jun: 10:00–11:15 (we can compress to 45+30 if we start promptly)
- Wed 23 Jun: 13:00–14:30

If you prefer evening hours, we can also offer Tue 22 Jun 17:30–19:00 PT but that’s less ideal for some engineers.

I’ll hold Tue 22 10:00 as tentative. Can you confirm ACME attendees? I’ll assemble a short agenda and an evidence pre-read (link included) so the call can be efficient.

Also flagged two evidence pieces we’ll want to demo live: config export for retention policy and the audit-log ingestion sample (we can share a redacted sample in-advance).

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Senior PM, Trust & Security — Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Alice Parker <alice@acme.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 & DPA walkthrough — propose a condensed two-part session

Quick note from infra: Tue 22 Jun 10:00 PT works for me. If we do the 45/30 split, please ask Acme to prioritize any architecture questions up front (scoping, egress controls, key management) so we can use the evidence time for document handoff and live screenshots.

I’ll bring a short diagram and a 3-bullet mapping to the SOC 2 categories.

Laura
Principal Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Jon Vega <jon.vega@acme.io>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Parker <alice@acme.io>, SecurityOps Team <secops@acme.io>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 & DPA walkthrough — propose a condensed two-part session

Hi Michael et al,

Thanks — Tue 22 Jun 10:00 PT is good for the Acme team (Alice, Jon, and our Head of Procurement will join). We’re happy to push architecture questions to the first 45 minutes and keep the final 30 for evidence handoff.

One ask: can Redwood mark the calendar invite as "private" and include a dial-in bridge (we’ll need to route through our corporate VPN)? Also please add the HubSpot record and a DocuSign pre-link for our legal team in the invite notes if possible.

We confirm attendees: Alice Parker, Jon Vega, Maria Ortiz (Procurement).

See you then — Jon
Security Operations, Acme Payments
